column1: # Default "2 Apps" scheme: launcher (factory) + 2 OTA app slots + data areas.
# Fixed layout: upgrading the old 8 MB slot requires a verified full backup and
# tools/prepare_multiboot_upgrade.py. app0 must fit 4 MB and its upper half be erased.
# Data partitions retain their existing offsets. launch_req is consumed by the
# one-shot bootloader before starting an OTA app; RESET returns to factory.
